dishes.name: Warnemünde Bückling
dishes.desc: Whole smoked herring, eaten warm at the fish stands on the Alter Strom harbour in Warnemünde.

dishes.name: Rostocker Fischsuppe
dishes.desc: Clear Baltic fish soup with vegetables and dill, served in harbour restaurants.

dishes.name: Fried herring
dishes.desc: Pan-fried herring marinated in vinegar, eaten with fried potatoes. A staple on Baltic coast menus around Rostock and Warnemünde.

dishes.name: Rote Grütze
dishes.desc: Red berry pudding with vanilla sauce or cream. A summer dessert that is part of Mecklenburg tradition.
